explanation: A COOL-Company-style campaign: opens on the pain of a fragmented adtech stack, resolves into one unified AI-powered platform (Create / Activate / Optimize), closes with a confident, low-friction CTA. Voice: confident, anti-complexity, performance-first, no fluff.

frame_1.description: Chaotic montage of overlapping dashboards, tangled charts and disconnected tools, dimly lit, conveying overload. Headline lands over it.

frame_2.description: The chaos resolves: a single sleek unified platform interface, calm and luminous. The triad 'CREATE. ACTIVATE. OPTIMIZE.' anchors the frame.

frame_3.description: Clean closing frame: brand mark, one confident line, and a direct CTA button.

frame_1.Background Image: dark moody scene of dozens of overlapping translucent analytics dashboards, tangled glowing chart lines and scattered browser windows, sense of digital chaos and overload
frame_1.Headline: Bold headline reading 'Five tools. Zero clarity.'
frame_1.Subtext: Supporting line reading 'Your ad stack shouldn't feel like this.'

frame_2.Background Image: single luminous unified analytics platform interface floating in calm dark space, clean modern UI, one coherent glowing dashboard replacing chaos, sense of order and control
frame_2.Headline: Triad headline reading 'CREATE. ACTIVATE. OPTIMIZE.'
frame_2.Subtext: Line reading 'One AI-powered platform. Every channel.'

frame_3.Logo: abstract minimal emblem of five fragments converging into one bold unified mark
frame_3.Headline: Closing line reading 'Performance, unified.'

frame_1.Background Image: top-down view of a cluttered desk with many glowing screens showing mismatched marketing dashboards, cinematic shadows, overwhelming complexity
frame_1.Headline: Headline reading 'Where did your ad spend go?'
frame_1.Subtext: Line reading 'Fragmented stacks hide the answer.'

frame_2.Background Image: elegant single control-room screen showing omnichannel campaign flows converging into one clear performance graph trending upward, confident cool light
frame_2.Headline: Headline reading 'No black boxes. No blind spots.'
frame_2.Subtext: Line reading 'Transparent attribution across every channel.'

frame_3.Logo: abstract minimal emblem of five fragments converging into one bold unified mark
frame_3.Headline: Closing line reading 'Adtech, finally in focus.'
